  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;

  const n = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return null;

  return Math.floor(n);
}

  const cleanUrl = asString(url)

  }

  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(cleanUrl)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid source URL: ${cleanUrl}. URL must start with "http" or "https".`);
  }

  return cleanUrl;
}

  const cleanUrl = normalizeUrl(url);
  const match = cleanUrl.match(/^(https?:\/\/[^/]+)/i);

  if (!match) {
    throw new Error(`Could not determine base URL from: ${cleanUrl}`);
  }

// Für Quellen mit resolve_pdf_from_page: true wird die Seite geladen und
// der neueste passende PDF-Link als url/source_url gesetzt.

// zuerst auf der Seite stehende Link (die Seite listet die neueste Ausgabe oben).
// ============================================================

const PDF_RESOLVE_USER_AGENT =
  'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';
const PDF_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS = 20000;

function absolutizeUrl(href, pageUrl) {
  const h = asString(href).replace(/&/g, '&').trim();
  if (!h) return '';
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(h)) return h;
  if (h.startsWith('//')) return 'https:' + h;
  const origin = (asString(pageUrl).match(/^(https?:\/\/[^/?#]+)/i) || [])[1] || '';
  if (h.startsWith('/')) return origin + h;
  const dir = asString(pageUrl).replace(/[?#].*$/, '').replace(/[^/]*$/, '');
  return dir + h;
}

function findPdfLinks(html, pageUrl, pattern) {
  const re = /href\s*=\s*["']([^"']+?\.pdf(?:[?#][^"']*)?)["']/gi;
  const seen = new Set();
  const out = [];
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null) {
    const abs = absolutizeUrl(m[1], pageUrl);
    if (!abs || seen.has(abs)) continue;
    if (pattern && !pattern.test(abs)) continue;
    seen.add(abs);
    const up = abs.match(/\/uploads\/(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\//);
    out.push({
      url: abs,
      order: out.length,
      uploadKey: up ? Number(up[1]) * 100 + Number(up[2]) : 0,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

  if (source.resolve_pdf_from_page !== true) continue;

  const pageUrl = source.url;
  source.page_url = pageUrl;
  source.pdf_resolved = false;

  try {
    const resp = await this.helpers.httpRequest({
      method: 'GET',
      url: pageUrl,
      headers: { 'User-Agent': PDF_RESOLVE_USER_AGENT },
      json: false,
      timeout: PDF_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS,
    });
    const html = typeof resp === 'string' ? resp : String(resp ?? '');
    const pattern = source.pdf_link_pattern ? new RegExp(source.pdf_link_pattern, 'i') : null;
    const candidates = findPdfLinks(html, pageUrl, pattern);

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`kein passender PDF-Link auf ${pageUrl} gefunden (Muster: ${source.pdf_link_pattern || '–'})`);
    }

    candidates.sort((a, b) => (b.uploadKey - a.uploadKey) || (a.order - b.order));
    const pdfUrl = normalizeUrl(candidates[0].url);

    Object.assign(source, {
      url: pdfUrl,
      source_url: pdfUrl,
      sourceUrl: pdfUrl,
      base_url: getBaseUrl(pdfUrl),
      baseUrl: getBaseUrl(pdfUrl),
      pdf_url: pdfUrl,
      pdf_candidates: candidates.slice(0, 5).map((c) => c.url),
      pdf_resolved: true,
    });

    console.log(`[URL-Quellen] ${source.source_id}: PDF ermittelt → ${pdfUrl} (${candidates.length} Kandidaten)`);
  } catch (err) {
    source.pdf_resolve_error = asString(err && err.message ? err.message : err);
    console.log(`[URL-Quellen] ${source.source_id}: PDF-Link nicht ermittelt, nutze Seiten-URL. Grund: ${source.pdf_resolve_error}`);
  }
}

const enabledSourceIds = enabledSources.map(source => source.source_id);

return enabledSources.map(source => ({
  json: {
    ...source,
    run_context: {
      ...source.run_context,
      enabled_source_ids: enabledSourceIds,
      enabled_sources_count: enabledSources.length
    }
  }
}));

function buildRow(event, sourceFromItem, rootJson) {
  const detectedSource = detectSourceDefault(event, sourceFromItem, rootJson);

  const sourceId = firstNonEmpty(
    event.source_id,
    event.sourceId,
    sourceFromItem.source_id,
    sourceFromItem.sourceId,
    rootJson.source_id,
    rootJson.sourceId,
    detectedSource?.source_id
  );

  const sourceName = firstNonEmpty(
    event.source_name,
    event.sourceName,
    sourceFromItem.source_name,
    sourceFromItem.sourceName,
    sourceFromItem.name,
    rootJson.source_name,
    rootJson.sourceName,
    rootJson.name,
    detectedSource?.source_name
  );

  const url = normalizeUrl(firstNonEmpty(
    event.url,
    event.URL,
    event.source_url,
    event.sourceUrl,
    sourceFromItem.url,
    sourceFromItem.source_url,
    sourceFromItem.sourceUrl,
    rootJson.url,
    rootJson.source_url,
    rootJson.sourceUrl,
    detectedSource?.url
  ));

  const title = cleanTitle(firstNonEmpty(
    event.title,
    event.Titel,
    event.name,
    event.summary
  ));

  if (!title) return null;

  const dateStart = parseDateToIso(firstNonEmpty(
    event.date_start,
    event.dateStart,
    event.start_date,
    event.startDate,
    event.Datum,
    event.date
  ));

  let dateEnd = parseDateToIso(firstNonEmpty(
    event.date_end,
    event.dateEnd,
    event.end_date,
    event.endDate
  ));

  if (!dateStart) return null;
  if (dateEnd && compareIsoDates(dateEnd, dateStart) < 0) {
    dateEnd = null;
  }

  const times = normalizeTimes(event);

  const venue = firstNonEmpty(
    event.venue,
    event.Veranstaltungsort,
    event.location,
    event.location_name,
    event.place,
    detectedSource?.default_venue,
    sourceFromItem.default_venue,
    sourceFromItem.defaultVenue
  );

  const address = firstNonEmpty(
    event.address,
    event.Adresse,
    detectedSource?.default_address,
    sourceFromItem.default_address,
    sourceFromItem.defaultAddress
  );

  // Roh-City wie bisher; dient ab jetzt nur noch als Fallback für resolveOrt().
  const cityRaw = firstNonEmpty(
    event.city,
    event.Ort,
    detectedSource?.default_city,
    sourceFromItem.default_city,
    sourceFromItem.defaultCity
  );

  // Ort aus der tatsächlichen Adresse ableiten. Coerde <=> PLZ 48157.
  const city = resolveOrt(address, cityRaw);

  const organizer = firstNonEmpty(
    event.organizer,
    event.Veranstalter,
    detectedSource?.default_organizer,
    sourceFromItem.default_organizer,
    sourceFromItem.defaultOrganizer,
    sourceName
  );

  const categoryRaw = firstNonEmpty(
    event.category,
    event.Kategorie,
    detectedSource?.default_category,
    sourceFromItem.default_category,
    sourceFromItem.defaultCategory
  );

  const category = normalizeCategoryGerman(categoryRaw);

  const description = cleanDescription(firstNonEmpty(
    event.description_short,
    event.descriptionShort,
    event.short_description,
    event.Kurzbeschreibung,
    event.description,
    event.details
  ));

  const confidence = normalizeConfidence(firstNonEmpty(
    event.confidence,
    event.Confidence,
    event.score
  ));

  const minConfidence = Number(firstNonEmpty(
    sourceFromItem.min_confidence,
    sourceFromItem.minConfidence,
    rootJson.min_confidence,
    rootJson.minConfidence,
    MIN_CONFIDENCE_DEFAULT
  ));

  const notesParts = [];

  const extractionNotes = firstNonEmpty(
    event.extraction_notes,
    event.extractionNotes,
    event.notes,
    event.Hinweise_Prüfstatus
  );

  if (extractionNotes) notesParts.push(extractionNotes);
  if (confidence < minConfidence) notesParts.push(`Niedrige Extraktionssicherheit: ${confidence}`);
  if (!url) notesParts.push('URL konnte nicht ermittelt werden');
  if (event._recurrence_generated === true) notesParts.push('Serientermin aus Wiederholungsangabe erzeugt');

  // Absage-/Verschiebungs-Erkennung. Konservativ: nur flaggen +
  // publish blockieren. Das Event bleibt in der Sheet erhalten.
  let publish = '';
  if (detectCancellation(title, description)) {
    notesParts.push('Automatisch markiert: mögliche Absage/Verschiebung – bitte prüfen');
    publish = 'nein';
  }

  const displayDate = formatDisplayDate(dateStart, dateEnd);
  const displayTime = formatDisplayTime(times.time_start, times.time_end);

  const stableSourceId = firstNonEmpty(sourceId, detectedSource?.source_id, slugify(sourceName), 'unknown_source');

  const eventId = buildEventId({
    dateStart,
    timeStart: times.time_start,
    title,
    sourceId: stableSourceId
  });

  const sortKey = `${dateStart} ${times.time_start || '00:00'} ${normalizeForCompare(title)}`;

  return {
    event_id: eventId,
    sort_key: sortKey,
    Datum: displayDate,
    Uhrzeit: displayTime,
    Titel: title,
    Veranstaltungsort: venue,
    Adresse: address,
    Ort: city,
    Veranstalter: organizer,
    Kategorie: category,
    Kurzbeschreibung: description,
    Quelle: firstNonEmpty(sourceName, detectedSource?.source_name),
    URL: url,
    confidence,
    Hinweise_Prüfstatus: notesParts.join(' | '),
    publish: publish,
    date_start_iso: dateStart,
    date_end_iso: dateEnd || dateStart,
    time_start: times.time_start || '',
    time_end: times.time_end || '',
    source_id: stableSourceId
  };
}

// Ort-Normalisierung. Coerde hat ausschließlich PLZ 48157.
function resolveOrt(address, fallbackCity) {
  const a = asString(address);

  if (/\b48157\b/.test(a) || /coerde/i.test(a)) {
    return 'Münster-Coerde';
  }

  const plzCityMatch = a.match(/\b(\d{5})\b\s*([A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß][A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß\-\s]+)/);
  if (plzCityMatch) {
    const plz = plzCityMatch[1];
    const cityPart = plzCityMatch[2]
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/[,;].*$/, '')
      .trim();
    return cityPart ? `${plz} ${cityPart}` : plz;
  }

  const plzOnly = a.match(/\b(\d{5})\b/);
  if (plzOnly) {
    const fb = asString(fallbackCity).replace(/\b\d{5}\b/g, '').trim();
    return fb ? `${plzOnly[1]} ${fb}` : plzOnly[1];
  }

  const fb = asString(fallbackCity);
  if (/\b48157\b/.test(fb) || /coerde/i.test(fb)) {
    return 'Münster-Coerde';
  }
  return fb;
}

// Absage-/Verschiebungs-Erkennung. Prüft Titel + Kurzbeschreibung.
function detectCancellation(title, description) {
  const hay = `${asString(title)} ${asString(description)}`.toLowerCase();

  const patterns = [
    /\bentf[äa]llt\b/,
    /\babgesagt\b/,
    /\bf[äa]llt\s+(?:leider\s+)?aus\b/,
    /\bfindet\s+(?:leider\s+)?nicht\s+statt\b/,
    /\bverschoben\b/,
    /\bcancell?ed\b/,
    /\bmuss\s+(?:leider\s+)?ausfallen\b/
  ];

  return patterns.some((re) => re.test(hay));
}

    json.request_source,
    json.requestSource,
    json.input_source,
    json.inputSource
  ];

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (candidate && typeof candidate === 'object') {
      return candidate;
    }
  }

  return json;
}

function extractEventsFromJson(json) {
  if (!json || typeof json !== 'object') return [];

  const dataCarriers = [
    json,
    json.source,
    json.source && json.source.source
  ];

  for (const carrier of dataCarriers) {
    if (carrier && typeof carrier === 'object' &&
        Array.isArray(carrier.data) && carrier.data.length) {
      return carrier.data;
    }
  }

  const candidates = [
    json.openai_response,
    json.openAiResponse,
    json.openaiResponse,
    json.response,
    json.body,
    json.data,
    json.result,
    json
  ];

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const parsed = parseOpenAiCandidate(candidate);

    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed;
    }

    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
      // NEU: OpenAI Events ermitteln liefert jetzt ein JSON-Objekt { data: [...] }.
      // Dieses Feld muss explizit gelesen werden; sonst bleibt der Normalize-Output leer.
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.data)) return parsed.data;
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.events)) return parsed.events;
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.items)) return parsed.items;
      if (isSingleEventObject(parsed)) return [parsed];
    }
  }

  return [];
}

function isSingleEventObject(obj) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object' || Array.isArray(obj)) return false;
  const hasTitle = typeof obj.title === 'string' || typeof obj.Titel === 'string' || typeof obj.name === 'string';
  const hasDate = obj.start_date !== undefined || obj.startDate !== undefined ||
                  obj.date_start !== undefined || obj.Datum !== undefined || obj.date !== undefined;
  const hasEventId = typeof obj.event_id === 'string' || typeof obj.eventId === 'string';
  if (Array.isArray(obj.data) || Array.isArray(obj.events) || Array.isArray(obj.items)) return false;
  return (hasTitle && hasDate) || (hasEventId && hasTitle) || (hasEventId && hasDate);
}

function parseOpenAiCandidate(candidate) {
  if (candidate === null || candidate === undefined) return null;

  const obj = typeof candidate === 'string'
    ? parseMaybeJson(candidate)
    : candidate;

  if (!obj) return null;

  if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj;

  // NEU: Standardformat aus dem OpenAI-Prompt: { data: [...] }
  if (Array.isArray(obj.data)) return obj.data;

  if (Array.isArray(obj.events)) return obj.events;

  if (Array.isArray(obj.items)) return obj.items;

  const chatContent = obj.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
  if (chatContent) {
    const parsedChat = parseMaybeJson(chatContent);
    if (Array.isArray(parsedChat)) return parsedChat;
    if (parsedChat && Array.isArray(parsedChat.data)) return parsedChat.data;
    if (parsedChat && Array.isArray(parsedChat.items)) return parsedChat.items;
    if (parsedChat && Array.isArray(parsedChat.events)) return parsedChat.events;
    if (isSingleEventObject(parsedChat)) return [parsedChat];
    return parsedChat;
  }

  const completionText = obj.choices?.[0]?.text;
  if (completionText) {
    const parsedCompletion = parseMaybeJson(completionText);
    if (Array.isArray(parsedCompletion)) return parsedCompletion;
    if (parsedCompletion && Array.isArray(parsedCompletion.data)) return parsedCompletion.data;
    if (parsedCompletion && Array.isArray(parsedCompletion.events)) return parsedCompletion.events;
    if (parsedCompletion && Array.isArray(parsedCompletion.items)) return parsedCompletion.items;
    return parsedCompletion;
  }

  const responseText = obj.output?.[0]?.content?.[0]?.text;
  if (responseText) {
    const parsedResponse = parseMaybeJson(responseText);
    if (Array.isArray(parsedResponse)) return parsedResponse;
    if (parsedResponse && Array.isArray(parsedResponse.data)) return parsedResponse.data;
    if (parsedResponse && Array.isArray(parsedResponse.events)) return parsedResponse.events;
    if (parsedResponse && Array.isArray(parsedResponse.items)) return parsedResponse.items;
    return parsedResponse;
  }

  const responseContent = obj.message?.content || obj.content;
  if (responseContent) {
    const parsedContent = parseMaybeJson(responseContent);
    if (Array.isArray(parsedContent)) return parsedContent;
    if (parsedContent && Array.isArray(parsedContent.data)) return parsedContent.data;
    if (parsedContent && Array.isArray(parsedContent.events)) return parsedContent.events;
    if (parsedContent && Array.isArray(parsedContent.items)) return parsedContent.items;
    return parsedContent;
  }

  if (isSingleEventObject(obj)) return [obj];

  if (typeof obj === 'object') return obj;

  return null;
}

function parseMaybeJson(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;

  if (typeof value === 'object') return value;

  const text = String(value).trim();
  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    // weiter unten Fallback
  }

  const withoutFence = text
    .replace(/^```json\s*/i, '')
    .replace(/^```\s*/i, '')
    .replace(/```$/i, '')
    .trim();

  try {
    return JSON.parse(withoutFence);
  } catch (error) {
    // weiter unten Fallback
  }

  const firstBrace = withoutFence.indexOf('{');
  const lastBrace = withoutFence.lastIndexOf('}');

  if (firstBrace >= 0 && lastBrace > firstBrace) {
    const jsonPart = withoutFence.slice(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1);
    try {
      return JSON.parse(jsonPart);
    } catch (error) {
      // weiter unten Fallback auf Array
    }
  }

  const firstBracket = withoutFence.indexOf('[');
  const lastBracket = withoutFence.lastIndexOf(']');

  if (firstBracket >= 0 && lastBracket > firstBracket) {
    const jsonPart = withoutFence.slice(firstBracket, lastBracket + 1);
    try {
      return JSON.parse(jsonPart);
    } catch (error) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function detectSourceDefault(...objects) {
  const values = [];

  for (const obj of objects) {
    if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') continue;

    values.push(
      obj.source_id,
      obj.sourceId,
      obj.source_name,
      obj.sourceName,

      obj.url,
      obj.URL,

      obj.default_organizer,
      obj.defaultOrganizer,
      obj.default_venue,
      obj.defaultVenue,
      obj.organizer,
      obj.venue,
      obj.title
    );
  }

  const rawHaystack = values.map(asString).filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
  const normalizedHaystack = normalizeKey(rawHaystack);

  for (const sourceDefault of SOURCE_DEFAULTS) {
    for (const alias of sourceDefault.aliases || []) {

    const sourceUrlComparable = asString(sourceDefault.url)
      .toLowerCase()

      .replace(/^www\./, '')

    if (sourceUrlComparable && rawHaystack.includes(sourceUrlComparable)) {

    }
  }

  return null;
}

function normalizeCategoryGerman(category) {
  const original = asString(category);
  if (!original) return '';

  const key = normalizeKey(original);
  return CATEGORY_MAP[key] || original;
}

function normalizeTimes(event) {
  const startRaw = firstNonEmpty(
    event.time_start,
    event.timeStart,
    event.start_time,
    event.startTime,
    event.Uhrzeit,
    event.time
  );

  const endRaw = firstNonEmpty(
    event.time_end,
    event.timeEnd,
    event.end_time,
    event.endTime
  );

  const range = parseTimeRange(startRaw);

  let timeStart = parseTimeToHHMM(startRaw);
  let timeEnd = parseTimeToHHMM(endRaw);

  if (range) {
    timeStart = range.start || timeStart;
    timeEnd = range.end || timeEnd;
  }

  return {
    time_start: timeStart,
    time_end: timeEnd
  };
}

function parseTimeRange(value) {
  const text = asString(value)
    .replace(/Uhr/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!text) return null;

  const match = text.match(/(\d{1,2})(?::|\.)(\d{2})\s*(?:[–—-]|bis)\s*(\d{1,2})(?::|\.)(\d{2})/i);

  if (!match) return null;

  return {
    start: `${pad2(match[1])}:${pad2(match[2])}`,
    end: `${pad2(match[3])}:${pad2(match[4])}`
  };
}

function parseTimeToHHMM(value) {
  const text = asString(value)
    .replace(/ /g, ' ')
    .replace(/Uhr/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  const match = text.match(/(?:ab\s*)?(?:ca\.\s*)?(\d{1,2})(?:(?::|\.)(\d{2}))?/i);

  if (!match) return '';

  const hour = Number(match[1]);
  const minute = match[2] === undefined ? 0 : Number(match[2]);

  if (Number.isNaN(hour) || Number.isNaN(minute)) return '';
  if (hour < 0 || hour > 23 || minute < 0 || minute > 59) return '';

  return `${pad2(hour)}:${pad2(minute)}`;
}

function parseDateToIso(value) {
  const text = asString(value)
    .replace(/ /g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!text || text.toLowerCase() === 'null') return null;

  const isoMatch = text.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
  if (isoMatch) {
    return `${isoMatch[1]}-${isoMatch[2]}-${isoMatch[3]}`;
  }

  const germanNumericMatch = text.match(/^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{2,4})$/);
  if (germanNumericMatch) {
    const day = Number(germanNumericMatch[1]);
    const month = Number(germanNumericMatch[2]);
    let year = Number(germanNumericMatch[3]);

    if (year < 100) year += 2000;

    return buildIsoDate(year, month, day);
  }

  const germanTextMatch = text.toLowerCase().match(/(\d{1,2})\.\s*([a-zäöüß]+)\s+(\d{4})/i);
  if (germanTextMatch) {
    const day = Number(germanTextMatch[1]);
    const monthName = germanTextMatch[2].toLowerCase();
    const year = Number(germanTextMatch[3]);
    const month = MONTHS_DE[monthName];

    if (month) {
      return buildIsoDate(year, month, day);
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function buildIsoDate(year, month, day) {
  if (!year || !month || !day) return null;

  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  if (
    date.getUTCFullYear() !== year ||
    date.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 ||
    date.getUTCDate() !== day
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return formatIsoDate(date);
}

function formatDisplayDate(dateStartIso, dateEndIso) {
  if (!dateStartIso) return '';

  const start = formatGermanDate(dateStartIso);
  const end = dateEndIso && dateEndIso !== dateStartIso
    ? formatGermanDate(dateEndIso)
    : '';

  return end ? `${start}–${end}` : start;
}

function formatDisplayTime(timeStart, timeEnd) {
  if (timeStart && timeEnd) return `${timeStart}–${timeEnd}`;
  if (timeStart) return timeStart;
  return '';
}

function formatGermanDate(iso) {
  const parts = asString(iso).split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return '';
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
}

function getTodayIsoInTimeZone(timeZone) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  }).formatToParts(new Date());

  const year = parts.find(p => p.type === 'year')?.value;
  const month = parts.find(p => p.type === 'month')?.value;
  const day = parts.find(p => p.type === 'day')?.value;

  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function addMonthsIso(isoDate, monthsToAdd) {
  const [year, month, day] = isoDate.split('-').map(Number);
  const targetMonthIndex = month - 1 + monthsToAdd;
  const lastDayOfTargetMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(year, targetMonthIndex + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
  const safeDay = Math.min(day, lastDayOfTargetMonth);
  return formatIsoDate(new Date(Date.UTC(year, targetMonthIndex, safeDay)));
}

function addDaysIso(isoDate, daysToAdd) {
  const [year, month, day] = isoDate.split('-').map(Number);
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + daysToAdd);
  return formatIsoDate(date);
}

function diffDaysIso(fromIso, toIso) {
  const from = isoToDate(fromIso);
  const to = isoToDate(toIso);
  if (!from || !to) return 0;
  return Math.round((to.getTime() - from.getTime()) / 86400000);
}

function isoToDate(isoDate) {
  if (!isoDate) return null;
  const [year, month, day] = isoDate.split('-').map(Number);
  if (!year || !month || !day) return null;
  return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
}

function formatIsoDate(date) {
  return [
    date.getUTCFullYear(),
    pad2(date.getUTCMonth() + 1),
    pad2(date.getUTCDate())
  ].join('-');
}

function compareIsoDates(a, b) {
  return asString(a).localeCompare(asString(b));
}

function expandRecurringEvent(event, windowStartIso, windowEndIso) {
  const recStartIso = windowStartIso;
  const recEndIso = addDaysIso(windowStartIso, RECURRENCE_WINDOW_DAYS);

  const dateStart = parseDateToIso(firstNonEmpty(
    event.date_start,
    event.dateStart,
    event.start_date,
    event.startDate,
    event.Datum,
    event.date
  ));

  const dateEnd = parseDateToIso(firstNonEmpty(
    event.date_end,
    event.dateEnd,
    event.end_date,
    event.endDate
  ));

  const durationDays = dateStart && dateEnd && compareIsoDates(dateEnd, dateStart) >= 0
    ? diffDaysIso(dateStart, dateEnd)
    : 0;

  const text = [
    event.title,
    event.Titel,
    event.short_description,
    event.description_short,
    event.descriptionShort,
    event.description,
    event.details,
    event.extraction_notes,
    event.extractionNotes,
    event.notes
  ].map(asString).join(' ');

  let pattern = patternFromStructuredFields(event);
  if (!pattern) pattern = detectRecurrencePattern(text);

  if (!pattern) return [event];

  const statusText = deAccentLower(`${asString(event.status)} ${text}`);
  const looksCancelled = /\bentfallt\b|\babgesagt\b|\bfallt\s+(?:leider\s+)?aus\b|\bverschoben\b|\bcancell?ed\b|postponed/.test(statusText);
  if (looksCancelled) return [event];

  let dates = [];
  if (pattern.kind === 'weekly') {
    dates = weeklyOccurrenceDates(pattern.weekday, recStartIso, recEndIso);
  } else if (pattern.kind === 'nth') {
    dates = nthWeekdayOccurrenceDates(pattern.ordinal, pattern.weekday, recStartIso, recEndIso);
  }

  if (!dates.length) {
    return dateStart ? [event] : [event];
  }

  return dates.map((iso) => cloneEventWithDate(event, iso, durationDays, true));
}

function endOfNextMonthIso(isoDate) {
  const [year, month] = asString(isoDate).split('-').map(Number);
  if (!year || !month) return isoDate;
  return formatIsoDate(new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 1, 0)));
}

// Liest ein Wiederholungsmuster aus den strukturierten LLM-Feldern.
function patternFromStructuredFields(event) {
  const rec = asString(event.recurrence).toLowerCase();
  if (rec !== 'weekly' && rec !== 'monthly_nth') return null;

  const wdRaw = event.weekday;
  if (wdRaw === null || wdRaw === undefined || wdRaw === '') return null;
  const wdNum = Number(wdRaw);
  if (!Number.isFinite(wdNum)) return null;

  let weekday;
  if (wdNum === 7) weekday = 0;
  else if (wdNum >= 1 && wdNum <= 6) weekday = wdNum;
  else if (wdNum === 0) weekday = 0;
  else return null;

  if (rec === 'weekly') {
    return { kind: 'weekly', weekday };
  }

  const womRaw = event.week_of_month;
  const wom = Number(womRaw);
  if (!Number.isFinite(wom) || wom === 0) return null;
  const ordinal = wom === -1 ? -1 : Math.max(1, Math.min(5, wom));
  return { kind: 'nth', ordinal, weekday };
}

// Erkennt Wiederholungsmuster rein aus Freitext.
// "jeden <Wochentag>"                     -> weekly
// "jeden <ersten..letzten> <Wochentag>"   -> nth (1..4, -1)
// "woechentlich" + <Wochentag>            -> weekly  (NEU, Lösung A)
// "<wochentag>s" (mittwochs, montags ...) -> weekly  (NEU, Lösung A)
function detectRecurrencePattern(text) {
  const t = deAccentLower(text);

  // --- Variante 1: explizites "jeden ..." (wie bisher) ---
  if (/\bjeden\b/.test(t)) {
    // Zuerst die spezifischere Variante: jeden <ordinal> <wochentag>
    const nthMatch = t.match(/jeden\s+([a-z]+)\s+([a-z]+)/);
    if (nthMatch) {
      const ordinal = RECURRENCE_ORDINALS[nthMatch[1]];
      const weekday = RECURRENCE_WEEKDAYS[nthMatch[2]];
      if (ordinal !== undefined && weekday !== undefined) {
        return { kind: 'nth', ordinal, weekday };
      }
    }

    // Dann die woechentliche Variante: jeden <wochentag>
    const weeklyMatch = t.match(/jeden\s+([a-z]+)/);
    if (weeklyMatch) {
      const weekday = RECURRENCE_WEEKDAYS[weeklyMatch[1]];
      if (weekday !== undefined) {
        return { kind: 'weekly', weekday };
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Variante 2 (NEU): Adverbiale Wochentage "mittwochs", "montags" ... ---
  // Deckt "mittwochs 9-15 Uhr", "immer mittwochs", "woechentlich mittwochs" ab.
  // deAccentLower hat Umlaute bereits entfernt; die "s"-Endung wird gekappt,
  // damit der RECURRENCE_WEEKDAYS-Key (mittwoch, dienstag ...) passt.
  const adverbMatch = t.match(/\b(montags|dienstags|mittwochs|donnerstags|freitags|samstags|sonntags|sonnabends)\b/);
  if (adverbMatch) {
    const base = adverbMatch[1].replace(/s$/, ''); // "mittwochs" -> "mittwoch"
    const weekday = RECURRENCE_WEEKDAYS[base];
    if (weekday !== undefined) {
      return { kind: 'weekly', weekday };
    }
  }

  // --- Variante 3 (NEU): "woechentlich" + irgendwo ein Wochentagsname ---
  // Fallback fuer "Woechentliche Migrationsberatung ... Mittwoch ..."
  // (DRK-Migrationsberatung). deAccentLower macht "wöchentlich" -> "wochentlich".
  if (/\bwochentlich\b/.test(t)) {
    for (const [name, wd] of Object.entries(RECURRENCE_WEEKDAYS)) {
      const re = new RegExp(`\\b${name}\\b`);
      if (re.test(t)) {
        return { kind: 'weekly', weekday: wd };
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function weeklyOccurrenceDates(weekday, startIso, endIso) {
  const out = [];
  let cursor = startIso;
  let guard = 0;
  while (isoToDate(cursor).getUTCDay() !== weekday && guard < 7) {
    cursor = addDaysIso(cursor, 1);
    guard++;
  }
  while (compareIsoDates(cursor, endIso) <= 0) {
    out.push(cursor);
    cursor = addDaysIso(cursor, 7);
  }
  return out;
}

function nthWeekdayOccurrenceDates(ordinal, weekday, startIso, endIso) {
  const out = [];
  const start = isoToDate(startIso);
  const end = isoToDate(endIso);
  if (!start || !end) return out;

  let year = start.getUTCFullYear();
  let monthIndex = start.getUTCMonth();
  const endYear = end.getUTCFullYear();
  const endMonthIndex = end.getUTCMonth();

  while (year < endYear || (year === endYear && monthIndex <= endMonthIndex)) {
    let day;
    if (ordinal > 0) {
      const first = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex, 1));
      const offset = (weekday - first.getUTCDay() + 7) % 7;
      day = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex, 1 + offset + (ordinal - 1) * 7));
      if (day.getUTCMonth() !== monthIndex) {
        monthIndex++;
        if (monthIndex > 11) { monthIndex = 0; year++; }
        continue;
      }
    } else {
      const last = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex + 1, 0));
      const offset = (last.getUTCDay() - weekday + 7) % 7;
      day = new Date(Date.UTC(year, monthIndex + 1, 0 - offset));
    }

    const iso = formatIsoDate(day);
    if (compareIsoDates(iso, startIso) >= 0 && compareIsoDates(iso, endIso) <= 0) {
      out.push(iso);
    }

    monthIndex++;
    if (monthIndex > 11) { monthIndex = 0; year++; }
  }

  return out;
}

function deAccentLower(value) {
  return asString(value)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/ä/g, 'a')
    .replace(/ö/g, 'o')
    .replace(/ü/g, 'u')
    .replace(/ß/g, 'ss');
}

function cloneEventWithDate(event, dateStartIso, durationDays, generated) {
  const clone = { ...event };
  clone.date_start = dateStartIso;
  clone.date_end = durationDays > 0 ? addDaysIso(dateStartIso, durationDays) : dateStartIso;

  if (generated) {
    clone._recurrence_generated = true;
  }

  return clone;
}

function dedupeRows(rows) {
  const sortedRows = [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
    const sortA = asString(a.sort_key);
    const sortB = asString(b.sort_key);
    return sortA.localeCompare(sortB, 'de');
  });

  const result = [];

  for (const row of sortedRows) {
    const duplicateIndex = result.findIndex(existing => areLikelyDuplicates(existing, row));

    if (duplicateIndex === -1) {
      result.push(row);
    } else {
      result[duplicateIndex] = choosePreferredRow(result[duplicateIndex], row);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function areLikelyDuplicates(a, b) {
  if (!a || !b) return false;

  const sameDate = a.date_start_iso === b.date_start_iso;
  if (!sameDate) return false;

  const titleA = normalizeForCompare(a.Titel);
  const titleB = normalizeForCompare(b.Titel);
  if (!titleA || !titleB) return false;

  const canonicalA = canonicalTitle(titleA);
  const canonicalB = canonicalTitle(titleB);
  if (canonicalA && canonicalA === canonicalB) return true;

  const sameUrl = normalizeUrl(a.URL) && normalizeUrl(a.URL) === normalizeUrl(b.URL);
  if (sameUrl) return true;

  const ta = asString(a.time_start);
  const tb = asString(b.time_start);
  const timesCompatible = (ta === tb) || !ta || !tb;
  if (!timesCompatible) return false;

  if (titleA === titleB) return true;

  const similarity = titleSimilarity(titleA, titleB);
  if (similarity >= 0.72) return true;

  return false;
}

function canonicalTitle(normalizedTitle) {
  const t = normalizeKey(normalizedTitle);

  if (t.includes('vorlesecafe') || t.includes('vorlesekafe')) return 'vorlesecafe';
  if (t.includes('sprachcafe') || t.includes('sprachkafe')) return 'sprachcafe';
  if (t.includes('joblots')) return 'joblotsinnen';
  if (t.includes('sortierpapier')) return 'sortierpapier';
  if (t.includes('tanzxchange')) return 'tanzxchange';
  if (t.includes('coerdinale')) return 'coerdinale';
  if (t.includes('offenesprechstunde')) return 'offenesprechstunde';
  if (t.includes('freizeittrefffurfamilien') || t.includes('freizeittrefffuerfamilien')) return 'freizeittrefffamilien';

  return '';
}

function titleSimilarity(a, b) {
  const tokensA = tokenSet(a);
  const tokensB = tokenSet(b);

  if (!tokensA.size || !tokensB.size) return 0;

  let intersection = 0;
  for (const token of tokensA) {
    if (tokensB.has(token)) intersection++;
  }

  const union = new Set([...tokensA, ...tokensB]).size;
  return union ? intersection / union : 0;
}

function tokenSet(value) {
  return new Set(
    normalizeForCompare(value)
      .split(' ')
      .map(token => token.trim())
      .filter(token => token.length > 1)
      .filter(token => !STOPWORDS.has(token))
  );
}

function choosePreferredRow(a, b) {
  const scoreA = rowQualityScore(a);
  const scoreB = rowQualityScore(b);

  if (scoreB > scoreA) return b;
  return a;
}

function rowQualityScore(row) {
  let score = 0;

  if (asString(row.URL)) score += 20;
  if (asString(row.Quelle)) score += 5;
  if (asString(row.Veranstaltungsort)) score += 5;
  if (asString(row.Adresse)) score += 3;
  if (asString(row.Ort)) score += 3;
  if (asString(row.Veranstalter)) score += 4;
  if (asString(row.Kategorie)) score += 2;
  if (asString(row.Kurzbeschreibung)) score += Math.min(10, asString(row.Kurzbeschreibung).length / 40);
  if (Number(row.confidence) >= 0.9) score += 3;

  const url = asString(row.URL).toLowerCase();
  if (url.includes('stadt-muenster.de')) score += 2;
  if (url.includes('kulturinitiative-coerde.de')) score += 2;
  if (url.includes('awo-msl-re.de')) score += 2;

  return score;
}

function buildEventId({ dateStart, timeStart, title, sourceId }) {
  const timePart = timeStart ? timeStart.replace(':', '') : 'ganztag';
  const titlePart = slugify(title).slice(0, 80) || 'event';
  const sourcePart = slugify(sourceId).slice(0, 50) || 'source';

  return `${dateStart}_${timePart}_${titlePart}_${sourcePart}`;
}

function normalizeConfidence(value) {
  const raw = firstNonEmpty(value, 0.9);
  const text = asString(raw).replace(',', '.');

  const lowered = text.toLowerCase();
  if (lowered === 'high') return 0.9;
  if (lowered === 'medium') return 0.7;
  if (lowered === 'low') return 0.5;

  const number = Number(text);

  if (Number.isNaN(number)) return 0.9;
  if (number > 1 && number <= 100) return Math.round((number / 100) * 100) / 100;
  if (number < 0) return 0;
  if (number > 1) return 1;

  return Math.round(number * 100) / 100;
}

function isBlockedSource(...values) {
  const haystack = values.map(normalizeKey).join(' ');

  return BLOCKED_SOURCE_IDS.some(blocked => {
    const key = normalizeKey(blocked);
    return key && haystack.includes(key);
  });
}

function cleanTitle(value) {
  return decodeHtml(asString(value))
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/^[-–—:|]+/, '')
    .replace(/[-–—:|]+$/, '')
    .trim();
}

function cleanDescription(value) {
  const text = decodeHtml(asString(value))
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (text.length <= 500) return text;
  return `${text.slice(0, 497).trim()}...`;
}

function decodeHtml(value) {
  return asString(value)
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/ /g, ' ')
    .replace(/–/g, '–')
    .replace(/‘/g, '‘')
    .replace(/’/g, '’')
    .replace(/“/g, '“')
    .replace(/”/g, '”')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'/g, "'")
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>');
}

function normalizeUrl(value) {
  let url = asString(value)
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .trim();

  if (!url) return '';

  if (url.startsWith('//')) {
    url = `https:${url}`;
  }

  if (/^www\./i.test(url)) {
    url = `https://${url}`;
  }

  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
    return '';
  }

  return url;
}

function normalizeForCompare(value) {
  return asString(value)
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/ß/g, 'ss')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function normalizeKey(value) {
  return normalizeForCompare(value).replace(/\s+/g, '');
}

function slugify(value) {
  return normalizeForCompare(value)
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')
    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
}

function firstNonEmpty(...values) {
  for (const value of values) {
    const text = asString(value);
    if (text) return text;
  }

  return '';
}

function asString(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
  return String(value).trim();
}

function pad2(value) {
  return String(value).padStart(2, '0');
}
